raw_text: NPS Score: 8/10. Would love multi-cursor support in Find and Replace. Currently I have to run multiple searches which is slow.
NPS Score: 9/10. Copilot integration is amazing but the latency on slower connections is really noticeable.
NPS Score: 6/10. The extension management UI could be much cleaner. Hard to find extensions I'm looking for.
NPS Score: 7/10. Works great overall but wish there was better support for vertical split pane navigation.
CSAT: 5/5. Settings interface is very intuitive and well organized. Makes customization easy.
CSAT: 2/5. Search functionality doesn't work properly with regex patterns. Loses results inconsistently.
CSAT: 4/5. Workspace management is solid. The ability to save and restore workspaces is very helpful.
The remote development extension just changed my workflow for the better. Seamless cloud development setup.
I've been having issues with keyboard shortcuts conflicting with my OS shortcuts. Hard to customize properly.
Dark mode themes look great but wish there was an auto-switch option based on system time like other editors.
